info.name: Admin Management
info.description:
## Admins

### Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api/v1`

### Authentication
Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}`.

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `base_url` | API base URL |
| `admin_access_token` | Admin JWT (auto-set on login) |
| `admin_refresh_token` | Admin refresh token (auto-set on login) |

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public auth endpoints for admin sign-in.

request.description:
### Auth
None — public.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| username | string | YES | Admin username, 3–64 chars. |
| password | string | YES | Admin password, 8–128 chars. |

### Notes
On success, the test script saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken` into environment variables keyed by role (auto-detected from the response payload `user.role`).

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Invalid credentials |
| 422 | Validation failed |
| 429 | Auth throttle exceeded |

item.name: Profile
item.description: Admin self-profile endpoints. All routes require an admin access token.

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| firstName | string | Optional | 1–100 chars. Personal name characters only. |
| lastName | string | Optional | 1–100 chars. Personal name characters only. |
| phone | string \| null | Optional | Syrian phone, normalized to international form. |
| username | string | Optional | 3–64 chars. |
| password | string | Optional | 8–128 chars. |
| currentPassword | string | Conditional | **Required** when `username` or `password` is provided. |

### Validation
| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| firstName / lastName | name-character regex (`@IsName`) |
| phone | Syrian phone (`@SyriaPhone`) |
| currentPassword | required iff `username` or `password` is set |

### Notes
Undefined fields are skipped (no change). Send `null` only for nullable fields (`phone`) to clear them. To change credentials, include `currentPassword`.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token or wrong `currentPassword` |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 409 | `username` already taken |
| 422 | Validation failed |

formdata.description: Profile photo file. Allowed mime types and size limits are enforced by the storage layer (jpeg/png/webp; ~5MB).

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| photo | file | YES | Single file upload (multipart/form-data). Replaces any existing photo. |

### Notes
Replaces the previous photo if one exists. Subject to the upload throttle.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 413 | File too large |
| 415 | Unsupported media type |
| 429 | Upload throttle exceeded |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
None — reads the principal from the access token.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
